technicalExplanation: All triangles from left hand have X <= -0.000567, and right hand X >= +0.000567 because every vertex is bounded in a disjoint halfspace. Each triangle is a convex combination of vertices, so hand-hand triangle intersections are impossible under the static hand transforms and identical rigid UpperBodyBreath animation. Other mesh intersections not proven.
sampleMethod: Inward-oriented face centroids (Y=.505..557, normals X sign) to closest point on 20 nearest opposing triangles; normals dot < -0.5 and distance <=1.5mm, area is sum of matched sampled left face areas, not exact continuous physical contact patch.
